$comment: Ovrly contracts 0.1.0-draft (pre-1.0). Mirrors backend/services/api/schemas.py JobSummary: the client-visible columns of the jobs table (backend/services/jobs/models.py). Lease owner, lease expiry, fencing token, generation, payload and provider request id stay server-side.
title: Job
description: Summary of one durable queue job (BE-04, #16), nested in an investigation read and the target of the queue_cancel, queue_retry and queue_continue voice actions. state follows the job state machine; cancel_requested is the separate flag that distinguishes a requested cancellation (a worker still holds the lease) from the effective cancelled state. Clients map unknown state, stage and retry_class values to UNKNOWN.

cancel_requested.description: True once the owner asked for cancellation; the state becomes cancelled when the worker observes it or the lease expires. A published job never carries it.

attempts.description: Number of claims so far, including re-leases after a crash. Independent of the per-class retry counters.

retry_class.description: Class of the last scheduled retry, or of the terminal failure when state is failed; null otherwise.

available_at.description: When the job becomes claimable; in the future while a retry backoff is pending.
